# prismasdwan_performance_policy_set (Resource)

Manages a Prisma SD-WAN Performance Policy Set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Palo Alto Networks Inc. 2025
#
# Sample resource example for "performance_policy_set".
# This file is generated - do not edit by hand.
#
# Before using this example, configure the Prisma SD-WAN provider:
#
#   terraform {
#     required_providers {
#       prismasdwan = {
#         source  = "paloaltonetworks/prismasdwan"
#       }
#     }
#   }
#
#   provider "prismasdwan" {
#     host          = "api.sase.paloaltonetworks.com"
#     client_id     = "acmeuser@12345.iam.panserviceaccount.com"
#     client_secret = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
#     scope         = "tsg_id:12345"
#     auth_url      = "https://auth.apps.paloaltonetworks.com/am/oauth2/access_token"
#   }

resource "prismasdwan_performance_policy_set" "example" {
  clone_from      = "example_clone_from"
  description     = "Managed by Terraform"
  disabled        = false
  disabled_reason = "example_disabled_reason"
  inactive        = false
  inactive_reason = "example_inactive_reason"
  link_health_rules = [{
    actions = [{
      action_type = "raise_alarm"
      always_on   = false
      app_perf = {
        bad_health_thresholds = {
          clear_below = 10
          raise_above = 10
        }
        monitoring_approach = "moderate"
      }
      circuit_utilization_perf = {
        bad_health_thresholds = {
          clear_below = 10
          raise_above = 10
        }
        monitoring_approach = "moderate"
      }
      lqm_perf = {
        bad_health_thresholds = {
          clear_below = 10
          raise_above = 10
        }
        monitoring_approach = "moderate"
      }
      probe_perf = {
        bad_health_thresholds = {
          clear_below = 10
          raise_above = 10
        }
        monitoring_approach = "moderate"
      }
      sys_perf = {
        bad_health_thresholds = {
          clear_below = 10
          raise_above = 10
        }
        monitoring_approach = "moderate"
      }
    }]
    app_acceleration_update = false
    app_filters = {
      app_transfer_types = ["rt-audio"]
      application_ids    = ["<application_id>"]
    }
    default_rule        = false
    description         = "Managed by Terraform"
    disabled            = false
    disabled_reason     = "example_disabled_reason"
    enabled             = true
    inactive            = false
    inactive_reason     = "example_inactive_reason"
    name                = "example_name"
    network_context_ids = ["<network_context_id>"]
    path_filter_update  = false
    path_filters = [{
      label     = "public-1"
      path_type = "direct"
    }]
    policyset_id      = "<policyset_id>"
    region            = "example_region"
    service_label_ids = ["<service_label_id>"]
    tags              = ["terraform"]
    thresholdprofile = {
      circuit_utilization_metrics_thresholds = {
        percentage_circuit_utilization = 10
      }
      description     = "Managed by Terraform"
      disabled        = false
      disabled_reason = "example_disabled_reason"
      flow_metrics_thresholds = {
        percentage_flow_utilization = 10
      }
      hard_limit_app_metrics = {
        max_init_failure_rate = 10
        max_rtt               = 10
        udp_trt               = 10
      }
      inactive        = false
      inactive_reason = "example_inactive_reason"
      is_default      = false
      lqm_thresholds = {
        max_jitter      = 10
        max_latency     = 10
        max_packet_loss = 10
        min_mos         = 5
      }
      name   = "example_name"
      region = "example_region"
      soft_limit_app_metrics = {
        max_init_failure_rate = 10
        max_rtt               = 10
        udp_trt               = 10
      }
      synthetic_probe_thresholds = {
        dns_txn_failure_pct = {
          probe_config_id = "<probe_config_id>"
          value           = 10
        }
        init_failure_pct = {
          probe_config_id = "<probe_config_id>"
          value           = 10
        }
        jitter = {
          probe_config_id = "<probe_config_id>"
          value           = 10
        }
        latency = {
          probe_config_id = "<probe_config_id>"
          value           = 10
        }
        packet_loss = {
          probe_config_id = "<probe_config_id>"
          value           = 10
        }
      }
      system_health_metrics_thresholds = {
        cpu_utilization    = 10
        disk_utilization   = 10
        memory_utilization = 10
      }
      tags = ["terraform"]
    }
    thresholdprofile_id = "<thresholdprofile_id>"
    type                = "app_circuit_health"
  }]
  name = "example_name"
  policy_rules = [{
    description     = "Managed by Terraform"
    disabled        = false
    disabled_reason = "example_disabled_reason"
    inactive        = false
    inactive_reason = "example_inactive_reason"
    name            = "example_name"
    policyset_id    = "<policyset_id>"
    region          = "example_region"
    tags            = ["terraform"]
  }]
  region = "example_region"
  tags   = ["terraform"]
}
```
